jobs.employer_name: ISR International School on the Rhine GmbH
jobs.description:
Job Overview

ISR is accredited by the German authorities as an ‘Anerkannte Internationale Ergänzungsschule’ (International Supplementary School) and by the US accrediting agency Cognia (formerly known as AdvancED). ISR is an IB World School authorized to offer the IB Diploma Programme, and also offers Cambridge Assessment International Education (CAIE) IGCSE courses. The school is a certified member of the Council of International Schools (CIS).

We wish to hire a dedicated and qualified full-time Admissions Employee (m/f/d) to join our dynamic educational institution from Autumn, 2026.

The successful candidate should be outgoing, confident in communicating with a wide range of people and able to build positive relationships quickly. Strong interpersonal skills, a collaborative mindset and a flexible approach to work are essential. A general understanding of different school systems and educational pathways would be an advantage.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

- Proactively contact interested families, provide relevant information and identify their individual needs.
- Manage and respond to all incoming enquiries from prospective families in a timely and professional manner.
- Maintain accurate records in the admissions database and ensure consistent follow-up throughout the enquiry process.
- Conduct school tours during regular school operations and provide personalised guidance on ISR’s educational programs and school community.
- Support prospective families throughout the entire application and enrolment process.
- Represent ISR and present its educational concept at internal and external events.
- Attend and actively support the planning, coordination, and delivery of information sessions, open days, and Saturday Info Days.
- Build positive and trusting relationships with prospective families while ensuring a welcoming and professional experience at every stage

Qualifications

- Completed vocational training or a university degree.
- Previous experience in customer service, client advisory or sales.
- Excellent written and spoken English and German; additional language skills would be an advantage.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
- A professional, service-oriented and approachable manner.
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
- Flexibility, reliability and strong organisational skills.
- Strong IT skills, particularly in Microsoft Office applications.
- Experience with Veracross is an advantage

Job Benefits

We are looking for someone who can make an immediate impact in a fast-paced, dynamic, and rewarding working environment. In return, we offer a range of opportunities for professional growth and career development.

If you are enthusiastic, highly motivated, enjoy a challenge, and believe you can contribute to the continued growth and development of our new ISR Elementary School Düsseldorf, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Contacts

jobs.occupation: Legal Counsel - Employment and Works constitution law - Germany CEE (f/m/x) (Syndikus-Anwalt/-Anwältin)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Legal Counsel – Employment & Labor Law (f/m/x) to lead our Social Affairs function across Germany & CEE (Austria, Romania and Czech Republic). Based in Germany, in this strategic role, you will be the architect of our social dialogue for Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic. You will not only provide expert legal advice but also lead direct relationships with Employee Representatives and Works Councils in all four countries. You are responsible for negotiating agreements, ensuring compliance, and fostering a constructive social climate to support the Group’s transformation and growth in the region.

Day-to-day responsibilities

Regional Social Dialogue (DE, AT, RO, CZ)

- Germany (Betriebsrat): Lead negotiations on complex shop agreements (Betriebsvereinbarungen) regarding IT systems, mobile work, and restructuring. Manage co-determinationrights (Mitbestimmung) effectively.
- Austria (Betriebsrat): Lead the relationship with the Austrian Works Council. Navigate the specificities of the Austrian "Social Partnership" and negotiate local shop agreements in compliance with the Arbeitsverfassungsgesetz (ArbVG).
- Romania (Reprezentanții salariaților) and Czech Republic (Odborová organizace): Lead the relationship with the Works Councils.
- Harmonization: Ensure a consistent social strategy across Germany & CEE cluster while respecting local legislative nuances.

Employment Law Advisory

Legal Business Partner: Serve as the primary legal advisor to the HR Country 

- Individual Labor Law: Manage complex individual cases across the region: drafting termination notices, negotiating mutual separation agreements (Aufhebungsverträge / Mutual Termination Agreements), and handling disciplinary measures.
- Contracts: Maintain and update standard employment contract templates for Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic to ensure they remain compliant with the latest local case law.

Restructuring & Strategic Projects

- Transformation Support: Legally structure and execute organizational changes across the region (e.g.,§613a BGB transfers in Germany, AVRAG transfers in Austria).
- Compliance: Roll out Group compliance policies (GDPR, Whistleblowing, Code of Conduct) ensuring they meet the strict data privacy standards of Germany and the specific requirements of the Austrian market.

Litigation Management

- Dispute Resolution: Represent the company in labor court proceedings (Kündigungsschutzklagen) in Germany.
- External Supervision: Select and manage external legal counsel in Austria, Romania and Czech Republic for specific litigation or high-risk cases, ensuring cost control and alignment with Group strategy.

Who are we looking for

Experience & Qualifications

- 8 to 10+ years of experience in Labor Law/Social Affairs, preferably within an international matrix organization, an IT/Consulting firm, or a specialized law firm.
- Works Council Leadership: Mandatory experience leading negotiations with Works Councils.
- You must have deep expertise in the German Betriebsverfassungsgesetz.
- You must have experience or a strong capability to manage Austrian employee representation bodies.
- Regional Scope: Proven ability to manage legal topics across multiple jurisdictions (Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic).

Competencies

- Negotiation Skills: Ability to lead social dialogue in four different legal environments (example: co-determination of Germany).
- Pragmatism: Solution-oriented mindset; you enable business while managing risk.
- Languages: German (Native level) and English (Fluent) are required. French is a plus.

Perks & Benefits

- Regional Responsibility: A key role covering four distinct countries with strategic importance.
- Autonomy: You will be the lead expert for the region Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic, trusted to handle sensitive negotiations with the collaboration of the HR Country Manager.
- Transformation: The opportunity to accompany a high-growth group in structuring its social foundations in the German & CEE market.

jobs.occupation: Head of Risk (all genders welcome) (Leiter/in - Risikomanagement)
jobs.description:
Company

tk accelis Trading GmbH, formerly thyssenkrupp Materials Trading GmbH, is a dynamic trading and services company within the tk accelis Group. With approximately 300 employees worldwide, 14 locations across several continents, and annual revenue of over 2 billion euros, we serve more than 1,500 customers in the steel, raw materials, and manufacturing industries. Our portfolio includes over 350 products, which, in addition to steel products such as rolled steel and pipes, primarily consist raw materials such as alloys, non-ferrous metals, minerals, coke, coal, and ores. In addition to international trade, we offer customized solutions for the supply of modern technologies and equipment for the steel and raw materials industries. We focus on long-term, trust-based partnerships with suppliers and customers worldwide. Our expertise ranges from project development and financing solutions to global logistics—making us a reliable partner throughout the entire supply and value chain.

Your responsibilities

Together with your team, you will ensure the monitoring and effective management of price risks in international commodities trading

- Ensuring and further developing the calculation and reporting of relevant price risks in the international commodities business
- Managing derivative risk positions within defined risk mandates, in close coordination with the front office
- Compliance with relevant internal TK and external reporting requirements (including EMIR)
- Leading and developing a team of five FTEs; additionally, providing technical guidance to two decentralised risk controllers based abroad
- Acting as an active sparring partner for the trading division regarding hedging instruments, trading strategies, products and portfolio development
- Supporting and guiding the business in the implementation of new transactions and strategies, including coordination with TK AG’s central finance department as well as external brokers and banks
- Identifying and realising opportunities for improvement through the use of digital tools (Power BI, artificial intelligence, etc.)

Your profile

- A successfully completed degree in economics
- Expert in hedging and, consequently, international trading of commodity derivative positions on the London Metal Exchange (LME)
- Experienced in designing and implementing risk analyses and hedging strategies
- Commercial mindset, strong stakeholder focus, hands-on approach and results-oriented attitude
- Experience in effectively leading and developing teams
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, and the ability to explain complex topics clearly
- Entrepreneurial mindset
- A personable manner with good communication skills in German and English
- Empathy and a sense of humour

Don’t meet all the criteria in the job posting but still want to join tk accelis? We look forward to getting to know you!

Your benefits

- Flexible work schedules, remote work, and a variety of health promotion programs
- Excellent opportunities for personal and professional development within the team, the company, and the corporate group
- Attractive employee benefits, such as an outstanding company pension plan
- A modern workplace at the ruhrtechkampus in Essen, featuring a cafeteria, a café, ample parking, and good access to public transportation
- Additional corporate benefits, such as discounts on shopping, mobile phone plans, or sports activities

Have we piqued your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your online application in German or English via the “Apply Now” button!

Contact

Selina Elfert
Sourcing undamp; Recruiting
Tel: +49 173 606 1963

We value diversity

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications, irrespective of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion and beliefs, disability, age, or sexual orientation and identity.

Start Your Career at Telekom – Become Part of a Global Team!

 

Are you ready to conquer the world? Then you’ve come to the right place! Deutsche Telekom is represented in over 50 countries worldwide and is one of Europe’s leading telecommunications providers. Our products and services connect people and improve daily life. With the best network and a strong presence in the gigabit society, we set the standards. Our digital future is driven by more than 230,000 innovative minds. Become part of our team and shape your future with us.

 

 

Your Start Date – Completely Flexible:

 

Our trainee program starts at the beginning of every quarter – choose your preferred start date that suits you.

 

 

What Are You Waiting For?

 

Positions can be filled immediately. So, don’t wait too long – apply as soon as possible!

We look forward to receiving your application (CV & certificates) in English or German.

For more information about our trainee program, visit our career site (https://www.telekom.com/en/careers/students/trainee-program) .

 

Start your career with us and shape the digital future.

 

 

 

Additional Benefits:

 

- Guaranteed Target Position: Our trainees receive a permanent employment contract from the very beginning.
- Special Onboarding Program: You’ll receive a week of extensive onboarding, including networking, to ensure an optimal start to the program.
- Community as a Key Element: The trainee community is closely connected, with regular events to strengthen team cohesion.

- Mentorship Program: The "Start up!" community offers a mentorship program with experienced executives who support you in your career development.
- Buddy Concept: Each trainee is supported by a buddy during onboarding who is available to answer questions.
- Strategic Thinking: In addition to your project assignments, there’s the opportunity to work on additional strategic projects.

 

 

Your Tasks

 

For talents with an entrepreneurial mindset and the courage to shape the future, the "Start up!" trainee program offers 18 months of space to learn and develop. We provide you with a wide range of insights into our organization and the opportunity to step out of your comfort zone and explore new topics to reach your full potential.

 

Additionally, We Offer You:

 

- Take Charge of Your Career! You will have five project assignments: the first within Technology & Innovation. After that, you can choose your subsequent projects individually – across the entire company.
- Step Out of Your Comfort Zone! After your first assignment, you decide which topics you want to dive deeper into. During the program, we want you to step out of your comfort zone and explore new fields within Deutsche Telekom. We will support you with a broad network.
- Expand Your Network and Experience the Trainee Community! Fridays are reserved for the “Magenta Friday". All trainees come together to work on strategic, innovative growth topics outside of their own project assignments. Trainees work in different teams where they organize events, foster their development, or contribute to social initiatives.

- Understand Our Business! Take the opportunity to get to know Deutsche Telekom’s operational business. During our "Service Days," you can gain direct insights into how Deutsche Telekom works with customers. Choose your "Service Days", such as a day in customer service, a visit to a T-Shop, or a stop at one of our service centers. You’ll gain direct insights into how we turn customers into fans every day.

Your Profile

 

You have successfully completed a degree in economics, business administration, IT, Sales, Marketing or a comparable field of study – all degree levels (bachelor's, master's, doctorate) are welcome. You possess strong customer and service orientation.

You bring the following skills and qualifications:

- Service Orientation: You have a pronounced service mindset and strive to meet our customers' needs in the best possible way.

- Project Management, Consultancy: You have knowledge and initial experience in project management and/or management consultancy and are capable of effectively planning, coordinating, and successfully completing projects.
- Trends: You follow current trends and developments in the industry and bring fresh ideas and approaches to our projects and products.
- Sales and Marketing Experience: You have practical experience in sales and/or marketing. This enables you to understand customer needs, craft effective marketing strategies, and contribute to the development and execution of successful sales initiatives.
- Intercultural Competence: Our Start up! community thrives on its international diversity. Therefore, strong intercultural skills should be part of your DNA. International experience – whether through studying abroad, work & travel, etc. – is therefore a must.
- Social Engagement: As a Start up! trainee, you are passionate about driving change! Experience in social engagement and/or entrepreneurial projects is highly welcomed.

Severely disabled applicants with equal qualification will be given particular consideration.

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. The University Hospital Bonn (UKB) is one of Germany’s leading university hospitals, combining top-level performance in medicine and research with excellence in teaching. The following full-time **(38.5 hours/week) position is to be filled as soon as possible in the Division for Computational Radiology & Clinical AI (CCIBonn.ai)** of the University Hospital Bonn:

Software Engineer/Developer (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
Postdoctoral researcher (m/f/d) – Medical Department for Hematology, Oncology, and Cell Therapy Magdeburg Center for Cell and Immune Therapy

Third-party funding

The Faculty of Medicine of Otto von Guericke University Magdeburg, in close collaboration with the University Hospital Magdeburg, is a leading center for translational biomedical research in Germany. Major research priorities include Immunology, Cell and Immunotherapy, and Neurosciences.

We are seeking an outstanding and highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) to join our internationally active research program in immune metabolism, hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, and next-generation cellular immunotherapies.

Our group combines cutting-edge basic immunology with investigator-initiated clinical trials in allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation and CAR-T cell therapy. Through close integration of laboratory and clinical research, we aim to translate mechanistic discoveries into innovative immunotherapeutic strategies for patients with hematological malignancies and immune-mediated diseases.

Our research has been published in leading international journals including The Lancet, The Lancet Neurology, Blood, Journal of Hepatology, and Journal of Hematology and Oncology. We are looking for ambitious scientists who aspire to perform research at the highest international level and pursue an academic career.

The successful candidate will become part of the Magdeburg Center for Cell and Immune Therapy (MAzI), an interdisciplinary research platform integrating basic science, translational immunology, GMP manufacturing, and investigator-initiated clinical trials in cellular immunotherapy.

Research Project

The position is embedded within the Collaborative Research Center/Transregio SFB/TRR 221 and focuses on mechanisms of immune regulation and tolerance following allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, with translational extensions toward antigen-specific cellular therapies such as CAR-T cells.

A particular emphasis is placed on understanding how metabolic programming regulates T-cell fitness, persistence, and exhaustion and how these pathways can be therapeutically targeted to improve transplantation outcomes and next-generation cellular immunotherapies.

We offer:

- an internationally visible translational research program
- participation in innovative, high-impact research projects
- close interaction with clinician scientists and access to unique patient cohorts
- state-of-the-art technologies-
- a vibrant interdisciplinary research environment
- opportunities for national and international collaborations
- strong support for scientific independence and career development
- a family-friendly and supportive working environment

Living in Magdeburg:

- Magdeburg offers affordable housing, excellent research infrastructure, a high quality of life, and excellent transport connections to Berlin and other major German cities.

Your Responsibilities:

- design and lead an independent translational research project
- actively participate in the scientific development of MAZI
- contribute to the supervision of MSc, MD, and PhD students
- collaborate with national and international research partners
- present research findings at international conferences
- publish results in leading peer-reviewed journals
- contribute to grant applications and collaborative research initiatives

Your Profile:

- PhD in Immunology, Molecular Medicine, Biology, Biochemistry, or a related discipline
- excellent publication record, including at least two first-author (or shared first-author) original research articles in international peer-reviewed journals. Applicants with publications in leading journals will be particularly encouraged to apply.
- strong background in one or more of the following fields: Tumor immunology | Cellular immunotherapy | Immune metabolism | T-cell biology | Gene editing | Stem cell transplantation
- experience with murine models is highly desirable (FELASA B/C certification is an advantage)
- excellent written and spoken English (German language skills are not required)
- we particularly encourage applications from scientists with a strong commitment to scientific excellence and the ambition to establish an independent academic career.

Terms and Conditions:

- **Salary: **The salary group E 13 according to “ Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst der Länder.” awaits you.
- **Appointment: **The position is available immediately. The successful candidate is expected to start as soon as possible, but no later than December 2026. The appointment is funded until December 2029.
- **Work Location: **Universitätsklinikum Magdeburg A.ö.R., Leipziger Str. 44, 39120 Magdeburg
- Application Deadline: 04.09.2026.

For further questions, please contact Mr. Prof. Dr. Dimitrios Mougiakakos at 0391-67-13266 or at dimitrios.mougiakakos@med.ovgu.de

You will be part of a highly flexible development team for the MeTS Hardware Security Modules with members in Brussels, Aachen and abroad, so good communication skills are essential. This role is as another aspect also responsible for the close management and coordination of an offshore development team from our German office, ensuring the quality, consistency and timely delivery of the system software for the Hardware Security Module (HSM). - You are a technical leader able to lead and guide off-shore and in-house teams in architecture, analysis and developments for made-to-measure customer solutions.

- The ideal candidate should possess proficiency in C programming and embedded systems development, along with a strong understanding of cryptography.
- Experience with secure coding practices and security standards is essential.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills are also required to effectively collaborate with team members and stakeholders. 

These qualities are essential! We’re also looking for the following skills and experience:

- Specialist in computer science with a related university degree 
- Proven experience managing offshore or distributed development teams with close technical oversight 
- Strong aptitude for analysis, a results-oriented worker capable of finding creative solutions 
- Excellent team player with the ability to build trust and maintain productivity across cultural and geographical boundaries 
- Outstanding communication skills, and a good command of spoken and written English 
- Awareness of a range of development support tools

Who Are We Looking For 

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. In practice this means: 

- Experience with embedded systems and C development
